## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use each arm to grab one of the hand-sized bottle with ridged bottom and the curvy orange bottle with white section.

Task description: The targets are the dark bottle on the left with a yellow cap, blue label, and ribbed base, and the curved orange bottle on the right with an orange cap and white upper section. Each arm holds its corresponding bottle and lifts it into the target region at the table center near the robot.

Success criteria: The left arm holds the blue-label bottle and the right arm holds the orange curved bottle. Their position reference points must simultaneously enter the corresponding target regions slightly left and right of center near the robot, clearly suspended above the table. Merely grasping them in place or lifting them slightly is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Grasp the blue-label bottle at the straight middle of its labeled body, with pads on opposing sides. Avoid the ribbed lower base and sloped upper shoulder to reduce sliding from insufficient contact.
- Grasp the orange bottle at its waist below the white upper section. Keep both pads at the same height and avoid transitions into the shoulder and bulging base to reduce squeezing it off-center during closure.
- The gripper opening can be slightly wider than the selected section. Before closing, check from multiple views that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the bottle rather than inferring enclosure from image overlap alone.
- A tall green bottle is close to the right of the orange bottle. Approach through the gap on the center-table side and turn the wrist in an open area to reduce contact between the fingers or wrist and the neighboring bottle.
- When bringing the two bottles toward the center, leave clearance between the bottle bodies and grippers. If one slides after lifting, let its bottom rest on the table again before adjusting the grasp.
